description: Run the logic tests in tests/**/*.test.ts (keiko): the real game in Node, no browser, in milliseconds. Each failure has its message, the source line, and the game's tick, scene and state when it failed. Use after every change; write a test for each mechanic you add.

files.description: Test files relative to the root. Default: all.

filter.description: Only run tests whose name contains this text.

root.description: Project root. Absolute path, or relative to the server's root. Default: the server's root.
